{
  "root_cause": "Escape key in a submenu incorrectly closes all submenus of the root menu instead of only the current submenu.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the Escape key handler in the keyup listener for submenus to close only the toggle controlling the current submenu and focus that toggle, preserving parent submenu state.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/menubar.js",
      "sha256": "35aa52673b33aeb4479c15d3f7863ce741e0ce9eee109ee5c70ae02a87a30864",
      "before": "    } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n            // Hitting Escape:\n            // - Closes submenu.\n            // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n            preventEvent(event);\n            this.elements.rootMenu.closeChildren();\n            this.elements.rootMenu.focusCurrentChild();",
      "after": "    } else if (key === \"Escape\") {\n            // Hitting Escape:\n            // - Closes submenu.\n            // - Moves focus to parent menubar item.\n            preventEvent(event);\n            const toggle = this.elements.parentMenu.elements.submenuToggles.find(\n              t => t.elements.controlledMenu === this\n            );\n            if (toggle) {\n              toggle.close();\n              toggle.dom.toggle.focus();\n            }"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Escape will close only the innermost open submenu and return focus to its parent menu item, keeping any outer submenu open.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If a submenu somehow lacks a toggle, the close/focus logic would skip (safe fallback).",
    "Focus may not land correctly if the toggle element is not focusable (should be a link/button).",
    "Potential regression if other code relies on the previous behavior of closing all submenus."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify Escape on a leaf submenu item closes that submenu and focuses its parent menuitem while keeping the parent submenu open.",
    "Verify Escape on the root menubar with no open submenus results in no state change.",
    "Verify Escape works correctly when a submenu has its own open submenu (nested case).",
    "Ensure other keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Space/Enter, etc.) continues to function as expected."
  ]
}
